entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For returns or order inquiries, press 3.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF-8675309. You better not give me a hard time about this.

Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 32 days ago. So I can best assist you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I don't care what you call it! It doesn't work the way I want, the battery life is a joke, and I'm done with it. I want a refund. Are we clear?
I understand your frustration, Sam. I just need to confirm the return eligibility for you. Please hold for one moment while I check the policy.
Check the policy? I've had it a month! If you tell me it's too late I'm going to demand your manager. I'll write reviews on every website you can think of. This is ridiculous!

Thank you for your patience, Sam. I've confirmed everything. According to our return policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 32, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and start that return for you right now.
Wait, really? So you're just going to take it back? No problem?

That's correct. I am generating a pre-paid shipping label and it will be sent to the email address on your account within the next 5 minutes. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh. Well... okay then. That was... easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
